data.name: Deadlucre
data.detailed_description:
Deadlucre is an action-packed roguelike first-person shooter with a unique dark cartoon-like art-style and combat feel like old classic arcade shooters, but with a Vegas-style gambling twist!

  • GAMBLE WITH YOUR BLOOD

    You must use your own health to spin a slot machine to build your weapon so you can survive in this city. You can modify your revolver to fire like a shotgun or a machine gun!

    7 different unique mods with tiers 1 to 3, higher the tier, the more powerful it is. Electricity that pierces through enemies, unleash a plague that poisons a whole group or roll for explosive bullets and blow your opposition into pieces!

    Use the enemies’ own machines against them and wager for better and more powerful gun combinations. Will you go without upgrades and risk potentially dying or sacrifice your health for a stronger weapon?

  • HAND CRAFTED LEVELS AND ENCOUNTERS

    5 unique enemies who are different from each other, that you’ll need to use your skills in order to both dodge and punish, or they'll punish you first, use the terrain to your advantage!

    They’re constantly moving and hounding for you, so better learn to move and shoot or die. The worst mistake you could make is standing still.

  • FEATURES

    • Unique cartoony, yet dark art style

    • Use your own health to spin a slot machine to gamble for better weapon stats

    • 7 different unique mods with tiers 1-3, higher the tier the more powerful it is

    • Fast-paced arcade shooting action

    • Several hand-crafted levels

    • 5 different dangerous enemies that shouldn't be underestimated

    • Energetic soundtrack

    • Permanent upgrades to make your journey even bloodier

    • Infinitely scaling challenge from looping levels where enemies get stronger with every finished loop, try to see how far you can get!

data.short_description: Battle through the streets of a Casino-Cult infested city in this fast-paced roguelike first-person shooter where you build your weapon by gambling with your blood. Spin a slot machine to build your weapon and crush your enemies with ridiculous weapon stats or wager it all and perish in the fight.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel i5 6500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950, Radeon R7 360, or Intel HD Graphics 630
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Internal
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: None
